question: The value of 15 + 6.3 ÷ 7 – 3 × 1.3 – 2 is:
solution:
**Concept used:**

We will use the concept of "BODMAS"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42bb4721cca13c7a34266d1bfbf6127eca9333c261e2e7b7a1cf02e43d5d169d.png] 

5 + 0.9 - 3 × 1.3 – 2

⇒ 15 + 0.9 – 3.9 – 2

⇒ 15.9 – 3.9 – 2

⇒ 10

**The answer is 10**
